entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A scheming human monk from Tarkir who believes dragons are its rightful rulers.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Jeskai khan in the original timeline and Taigam's peer in the current one.

entities.name: Ebirri
entities.description: Rakshasa with whom Taigam made a pact.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: Sultai khan whose Hand Taigam became.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragonlord who showed appreciation for Narset.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who came to Tarkir to seek Narset's counsel and defeated Sarkhan Vol.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who lost his power; Taigam taught him the ritual and he became a corrupted dragon.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Dragon planeswalker whose return dispelled the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: The spell used by the khans to summon the Spirit Dragons, warped by the tainted offering.

entities.name: Storm Crane Monastery
entities.description: Flying Jeskai monastery where Taigam taught.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: Clan Taigam defected to in the original timeline.

events.summary: In the original timeline Taigam defected from the Jeskai to the Sultai Brood.
events.quote: Taigam defected to the Sultai Brood to find true power

events.summary: Narset and Shintan stopped a team of assassins sent by Taigam.
events.quote: they were stopped and knocked out by Narset and her bodyguard Shintan

events.summary: In the current timeline Taigam confronted and ousted Narset.
events.quote: she was eventually discovered, confronted, and ousted by Taigam

events.summary: After the dragonlords fell Taigam joined the Jeskai while secretly plotting a revival of the dragons.
events.quote: secretly plotted a revival of the dragons

events.summary: Taigam sought to turn Narset against Elspeth after a wild dragon attacked Storm Crane.
events.quote: Taigam took this opportunity to turn Narset against Elspeth.

events.summary: Taigam offered to help Sarkhan regain his power by killing a dragon and eating its heart.
events.quote: offered to help him regain the power he had lost in the Desparkening

events.summary: Sarkhan ate a dragon's heart and became a corrupted dragon, driving wild dragons into a frenzy until Ugin returned.
events.quote: He transformed into a massive, corrupted dragon

relations.quote: Taigam would later declare Narset a heretic
Trained in the Jeskai Way under khan Narset
As Sidisi 's Hand, he became the personal enforcer of the Sultai khan.
